coverage.name: Home Depot Canada
coverage.note: Anchor — batteries, 60V tools, and the only source for Husky benches. Every one of the 33 tracked Home Depot SKUs held its price for a tenth straight day, but the store lookup itself was corrected today: store 7024, used on the last run, is Barrie, and Edmonton Windermere is 7268, so yesterday's shelf counts were the wrong store's and today's are re-read against Windermere. The sweep found one genuine markdown worth adding, the DCHT870B 26-inch hedge trimmer bare tool at $268 from $328 — 18% off, which clears the group's line — plus two bare 60V tools that undercut rows already on the board: the DCBL770B blower at $239 and the DCST970B 15-inch trimmer at $269. Real shelf position at Windermere: DCB606 and DCB615 both read 0 with free ship to store, the DCB612 and DCB6112 are out of stock online with 2 and 3 left in store, the DCS578B holds at 1, the DCBL777B at 6 and the new hedge trimmer at 5. The DCED472 edger kit is down to 2 left online and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky to 4

coverage.name: Alberta Drywall & Stucco Supply
coverage.note: Edmonton contractor supplier at 6030 50 St NW. Every tracked row held on both price and stock — DCB606 $175 with 5, DCS388 $309.99 with 3, refurbished DCV585BR $395 with 5, refurbished DCD130B $279 with its last unit, DCBL770X1 bare tool $297 with 3, DCST970X1 bare tool $279 with 4, and the refurbished 21-inch snow blower kit at $1,099 with 3. The "flexvolt 60v" sweep returned 17 items against 16 yesterday and the "dewalt refurbished" sweep the same 161, with no new 60V bare tool in either. Two of its bare-tool rows lost their edge today: Home Depot lists the same DCBL770B blower at $239 against $297 here and the DCST970B trimmer at $269 against $279. The $315 DCD575-labelled "Flex Volt 60V 7¼" circular saw" is still listed and still left off, since the model code and specs read like a 20V saw

coverage.name: KMS Tools
coverage.note: Full FlexVolt dealer with an Edmonton store. Re-checked Sept 22 and nothing moved — DCB612 $328 and DCS578B $398 both still badged Super Special under MAP pricing and both in stock online, and the DCBL772X1 blower kit holds at $418 on Clearance. Abbotsford still reads sold out on the DCB612, 12 on the saw and 2 on the blower kit. With Amazon's bare DCS578B up to $299 today, KMS's $398 is now the dearest of the three sources for that saw rather than $129 adrift. KMS's monthly Flipp flyer is still the only flyer carrying FlexVolt in the postal code

coverage.name: Grainger Canada
coverage.note: Supplying two packs, both unchanged on the dated markdown: DCB606 $205.99 from $350.94 and DCB612 $345.99 from $518.71, with the offer end date still reading 30 Oct 2026 on both pages. Industrial pricing that moves on its own cycle rather than with retail flyer weeks. Availability needs a postal code and both packs are flagged for special shipping

coverage.name: Walmart.ca
coverage.note: Read cleanly again on Sept 22 and the DCB612 is confirmed at $328, sold and shipped by Preston Hardware with free delivery quoted by Sept 29, a day later than yesterday's window. At $27.33/Ah it ties KMS as the cheapest 12Ah pack on the board

coverage.name: Canadian Tire
coverage.note: Re-swept Sept 22 and still carries no 60V FlexVolt. Both "flexvolt 60v battery" and "dewalt 60v" return the same 2 hits they did yesterday — the DCA1820 18V-to-20V adaptor and the DCB104 multiport charger — so the narrowed matching seen yesterday is holding rather than being a one-day glitch. No 60V pack, no bare 60V tool, no Husky

coverage.name: Amazon.ca
coverage.note: The one retailer that moved today, and not in Mike's favour. Power Tools Inc's $269 offer on the DCS578B bare saw has gone; the buy box is now cell phone seller at $299 plus $14.94 delivery, with 3 left and all 6 new offers starting at $299, so the saw is $30 dearer and no longer ships free. On the DCB609 the buy box passed from Impact Distribution to savingsculture at $328.50 plus $5.50 delivery with a single unit left — $5.50 cheaper on paper, identical at $334 landed. Battery searches are still wall-to-wall third-party replacement packs

log.text: The ten-day standstill broke, though on the wrong side: Amazon's DCS578B bare circular saw jumped from $269 to $299 after Power Tools Inc's offer disappeared, and the new buy box adds $14.94 delivery on top, so the cheapest bare DCS578B anywhere is now $299 against Home Depot's $369 and KMS's $398. On the same site the DCB609 buy box passed from Impact Distribution to savingsculture at $328.50 with $5.50 shipping and a single unit left — a $5.50 cut on paper that lands at exactly the same $334. Every other price on the board held, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target, though it is down to 4 left online with none on the Windermere shelf. The day's find is a real flag: Home Depot's DCHT870B 26-inch hedge trimmer bare tool at $268 from $328 — 18% off, clearing the group's 15% line, with 5 on the shelf at Windermere — and two more bare 60V tools were added because they undercut rows already tracked, the DCBL770B blower at $239 against Alberta Drywall's $297 and the DCST970B 15-inch trimmer at $269 against its $279. A correction worth recording: the Home Depot store id used on the last run, 7024, is Barrie, not Windermere — Windermere is 7268 — so yesterday's Home Depot shelf counts were another store's, and today's were re-read against the right one. Everything else was quiet: KMS, Grainger and all seven Alberta Drywall rows held on price and stock, Walmart read cleanly and confirms the DCB612 at $328, both 72-inch heavy-duty Husky benches are still out, the Depot Drop week still runs to Sept 23 with no 60V or Husky pricing in it, and the Flipp sweep again found only KMS's monthly flyer with the same two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428. Canadian Tire and Rona were re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

A ninth straight day without a single tracked price moving — every row the sweep could read came back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The day's real change is a loss: the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench has gone out of stock online again, putting both 72-inch heavy-duty colours off the board and leaving the standard-duty gloss red at $1,198 as the only 72-inch still buyable. Home Depot's search grid refused to render, so the sweep ran through the site's own search API with the store set to Windermere, and it turned up two bare 60V tools the watch had been missing — the DCBL570B backpack blower at $698 from $759 and the DCPW1000B power cleaner at $298 from $329 — both added, though at 8% and 9% off neither clears the 15% line. Walmart read cleanly after yesterday's bot check and confirms the DCB612 at $328 from Preston Hardware, so that row is verified again, while the Amazon bare saw thinned from 4 units to 3 and both 61-inch Husky benches now read 0 on the Windermere shelf though both still ship to store free. Canadian Tire, Rona, KMS, Grainger and Alberta Drywall were all re-swept with nothing new: Canadian Tire's "dewalt 60v" search returned only 2 items today against 140 on earlier runs, but the answer is the same — no 60V FlexVolt anywhere in its range. The Flipp sweep again found only KMS's monthly flyer (Sept 1 – Oct 1) with two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428 that still cannot be identified.

Eighth straight day without a price move — every row the sweep could read came back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The day's finds are both at Alberta Drywall: the bare-tool option of the DCST970X1 60V string trimmer at $279 with 4 in stock, which undercuts Home Depot's DCST972B bare trimmer by $20, and a DeWalt-refurbished 21-inch single-stage snow blower kit at $1,099 with 3 in stock, $200 under Home Depot's new DCSNP2142Y2-CA — a refurbished 60V tool, so it clears the group's clearance rule outright. Supply kept thinning at the edges: the Amazon bare saw is down from 5 units to 4, Home Depot's own DCS578B is down to a single unit at Windermere, and KMS slipped from 13 to 12 on the same saw at Abbotsford. Walmart could not be read — its DCB612 listing answered with a press-and-hold bot check, so that row is carried forward at $328 and marked unverified. Home Depot's Must-See Deals week is the same one running to Sept 23, and its 105-item Depot Drop list still holds exactly one DeWalt entry, a construction tripod at $89.25 from $119. The Flipp sweep again found only KMS's monthly flyer (Sept 1 – Oct 1) with two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428 that still cannot be identified. Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

Seventh straight day without a price move — every tracked row read back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The good news is a restock: the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench is buyable again at $1,548 from $1,898, with an add-to-cart, delivery Sept 24–26 and free ship to Windermere, after reading out of stock yesterday — it is 18% off but still $149 above the $1,399 line, and the matte-black twin is still out. Widening the Alberta Drywall sweep added two 60V bare tools: a DeWalt-refurbished DCD130 mixer/drill bare tool at $279 with a single unit left, which clears the group's clearance rule outright and undercuts the same store's new DCD130 by $84.60, and the bare-tool option of the DCBL770X1 handheld blower at $297 with 3 in stock, against $499 for the kit. Supply kept thinning at the edges — the Amazon bare saw is down from 6 units to 5, and Walmart's DCB612 delivery slipped from Sept 25 to Sept 28 — while KMS is unchanged, still sold out at its lead store on the DCB612 and still $328 and $398 under MAP pricing. Home Depot's Must-See Deals week is the same one running to Sept 23, its only DeWalt entry a construction tripod at $89 from $119, with no 60V or Husky tool-storage pricing and the flyer widget rendering nothing again. Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

Sixth straight day without a price move — every tracked row read back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The real news is a loss: the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench has gone out of stock online and is not sold in-store, which puts both 72-inch heavy-duty colours off the board and leaves the lighter standard-duty gloss red at $1,198 as the only 72-inch still buyable. Widening the Alberta Drywall sweep paid off with two 60V bare tools Home Depot does not list: a DCS388 FlexVolt reciprocating saw at $309.99 with 3 in stock, $59 under Home Depot's DCS389B, and a DeWalt-refurbished DCV585B dust extractor bare tool at $395 with 5 in stock — a refurbished bare tool, which clears the group's clearance rule outright. A third Alberta Drywall listing, a $315 "Flex Volt 60V 7¼-inch circular saw" carrying model code DCD575, was deliberately left off: the code and the quoted specs both read like a 20V saw, and it needs confirming before it goes on the board. Supply thinned around the edges — the Amazon bare saw is down from 7 units to 6 with delivery pushed to Sept 24–28, the Amazon DCB609 slipped again to Sept 29 – Oct 7, and KMS now reads sold out at its lead store on the DCB612 after showing 10 yesterday, though it is still in stock online. Home Depot's Must-See Deals week is the same one, running to Sept 23, with no DeWalt 60V or Husky tool-storage pricing surfacing and the flyer widget rendering nothing again. Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

Fifth straight day with no price movement — every tracked row read back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. Two new Home Depot SKUs joined the 60V group, neither of them flagging: the DCBL777Y1 760 CFM blower kit with a 12Ah pack at $499 at regular price, and the DCCS670X1 16-inch chainsaw kit at $498 from $579 — 14% off, just under the 15% line, and out of stock at Windermere with delivery only. Stock read better than yesterday: the Home Depot DCS578B is back to plain in-stock after showing a single unit, and the battery shelf counts at Windermere are 5 on the DCB606-2, 4 on the DCB609-2 and 3 each on the DCB609 and DCB609C. Against that the Amazon bare saw slipped from 8 units to 7 and the Amazon DCB609 pushed its window out again to Sept 28 – Oct 6. A new online-only Must-See Deals week opened today and runs to Sept 23, but its Depot Drop list holds no DeWalt 60V and no Husky tool storage, and the flyer widget rendered nothing again. Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt. Later the same day the sweep was widened on Mike's go-ahead. Alberta Drywall & Stucco Supply, an Edmonton contractor supplier at 6030 50 St NW, joined the board with the DCB606 6.0Ah at $175 in stock for 24-hour pickup — $23 under Home Depot's sale price and the cheapest DCB606 anywhere on the watch, though at $29.17/Ah it still sits outside the $28/Ah flag. Grainger Canada joined with two packs on a markdown that runs to Oct 30: DCB606 $205.99 from $350.94 and DCB612 $345.99 from $518.71. Home Hardware, CanuckTools, Federated Tool, Atlas Machinery, Contractor Cave and NAPA Canada were all checked and skipped — each at or above prices already tracked, with CanuckTools and Federated Tool returning identical prices on identical pages and almost certainly one operator behind two storefronts.

Fourth straight day with no price movement — every one of the 35 tracked rows read back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The one real change is a restock: the 61-inch heavy-duty bench in matte black is back at Windermere with a single unit and free pickup from today, after reading 0 and delivery-only yesterday. Stock is thinning elsewhere — the DCB612 12Ah is now out of stock online with only limited store stock, the Home Depot DCS578B is down to 1 at Windermere, and the Amazon bare saw has slipped from 9 units to 8 with its window pushed to Sept 22–24 while the Amazon DCB609 now quotes Sept 25 – Oct 5. Walmart read cleanly this time and confirms the DCB612 at $328 from Preston Hardware, so that row is verified again. Home Depot's online-only Must-See Deals week ends today with no DeWalt 60V or Husky tool-storage pricing in it; Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

Third straight day without a single price move — every price the sweep could read held, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. Two bare 60V brushless tools joined the watch from Home Depot's search, both at regular price and neither flagging: the DCED472B attachment-capable edger at $299, which is $150 under the DCED472 kit already tracked, and the DCS520B 6½-inch tracksaw at $589 with stock at Windermere in aisle 16, bay 006. Small movements around the edges: the DCB6112 12Ah pack has a delivery option again (Sept 16) after showing none, the 61-inch matte-black bench now reads 0 at Windermere and is delivery-only with ship-to-store still unavailable, and the Amazon DCB609 has slipped another week to Sept 24 – Oct 2 while the bare saw there holds at $269 with 9 left. Canadian Tire and Rona are unchanged — no 60V FlexVolt at either. Two sites could not be read today: Walmart.ca answered with a press-and-hold bot check, so its DCB612 row is carried forward from Sept 14 and marked unverified, and Home Depot's flyer widget again rendered nothing, though the Specials page still shows the online-only Must-See Deals week ending Sept 16 with no DeWalt 60V or Husky tool-storage event pricing.

Second straight day with no price movement — all 28 tracked items held, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The news is a restock: the 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench in matte grey is back after two days out, 9 available with delivery Sept 18–20 or free ship to Windermere, still $1,548 from $1,898 — 18% off but well above the $1,399 line — while the matte-black twin remains out of stock online. Two new SKUs joined the sweep, both at regular price and neither flagging: the DCBL777B 780 CFM axial blower, a bare 60V tool at $349 with 5 on the shelf at Windermere, and the DCB609G oil-resistant 9.0Ah pack at $359, which is $20 over the plain DCB609 and a poor $39.89/Ah. Smaller notes: the tracked 61-inch matte-black bench has lost ship-to-store at Windermere and is delivery-only now, the Amazon bare saw is down to 9 units with its window pushed to Sept 18–22, and Canadian Tire and Rona are unchanged — still no 60V FlexVolt at either. Home Depot's flyer widget would not render today, so no flyer dates were read.

Not one tracked price moved today — all 28 items held, including DCB606 at $198, DCB609-2 at $428 and still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah, and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928, the only bench inside its target. What the sweep did turn up is three bare 60V brushless tools that Home Depot stocks at Windermere and the watch had been missing: the DCS578B circular saw at $369, the DCS389B reciprocating saw at $369, and the DCG418B grinder at $329, all three sitting in aisle 16, bay 004 and all at regular price, so none of them flag. The Home Depot DCS578B is the useful one, because it finally gives the Amazon listing a same-tool reference point and shows that $269 is $100 under the shelf price here. Worth noting but not tracked: DeWalt's 4-port 12V/20V/FlexVolt fast charger is cut to $228 from $349 — 35% off — at both Home Depot and Rona, but it's a charger, not a pack. Both 72-inch heavy-duty Husky benches are still out of stock online, the Amazon bare saw is down to 9 units, and Canadian Tire remains 12V/20V MAX only.

One real price cut and one supply loss. The Amazon listing for the DCS578B bare circular saw dropped from $278 to $269 — still Power Tools Inc, still only 10 left — which puts it $129 under KMS for the same bare tool. Against that, the 72-inch Husky bench is now effectively off the board: the matte-grey twin that replaced the black one yesterday has itself gone out of stock online, so both 72-inch heavy-duty colours are unavailable and the only 72-inch left is the lighter standard-duty gloss red at $1,198. Home Depot's search also turned up two SKUs worth tracking — a newer DCB6112 12Ah pack at $429 that is actually in stock at Windermere (aisle 16) while the older DCB612 has gone out of stock online, and the DCS781B bare 12-inch sliding miter saw at $969, which makes the $999 kit with a 9Ah battery and charger the obvious buy at $30 more. Everything else held: DCB606 $198, DCB609-2 $428 and still the best value at $23.78/Ah, DCB612 $328 at both KMS and Walmart. No target was newly cleared. Canadian Tire is still 12V/20V MAX only and Rona still lists no 60V packs.

Two additions and one restock, but no tracked price moved. Home Depot's own search surfaced the DCS781X1 12-inch FlexVolt sliding miter saw kit at $999, down from $1,249 — a 20% cut that clears the group's 15% line — and a matte-grey twin of the 72-inch Husky bench (H72MWC15GRY) at $1,548, was $1,898, which matters because the tracked matte-black version went out of stock online today and is not sold in stores, so the grey is now the only way to get that bench.
